shapes.frame_eqs_str: a.rad = 0.06 + a.bass_att * 0.07; a.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(a.time * 0.5) * 0.15; a.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(a.time * 0.7) * 0.15; a.r = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.time); a.g = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.time * 1.2); a.b = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(a.time * 1.4);
a.ang = a.time * 0.3; a.rad = 0.08 + a.mid_att * 0.05; a.x = 0.5 - Math.sin(a.time * 0.3) * 0.18; a.y = 0.5 - Math.cos(a.time * 0.5) * 0.18;

waves.point_eqs_str: a.angle = a.sample * 6.28 + a.time * 0.5; a.dist = 0.22 + a.value1 * 0.12 * a.bass_att; a.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.dist; a.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.dist; a.r = 0.0; a.g = 0.9; a.b = 1.0; a.a = 0.4;

a.angle = a.sample * 6.28 - a.time * 0.3; a.dist = 0.12 + a.value2 * 0.1 * a.mid_att; a.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.dist; a.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.dist; a.r = 1.0; a.g = 0.3; a.b = 0.8; a.a = 0.3;

frame_eqs_str: a.vol = (a.bass + a.mid + a.treb) * 0.33; a.vol_avg = a.vol_avg * 0.98 + a.vol * 0.02; a.q1 = (a.bass_att - a.vol_avg) * 0.15; a.q2 = (a.mid_att - a.vol_avg) * 0.2; a.q3 = 0.0035 + Math.sin(a.time * 0.2) * 0.001; a.q6 = Math.sin(a.time * 0.12) * 0.5 + 0.5; a.q7 = Math.cos(a.time * 0.16) * 0.5 + 0.5; a.q8 = Math.sin(a.time * 0.22) * 0.5 + 0.5;
warp: shader_body { vec3 main = texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz; vec3 blur = (texture(sampler_blur1, uv).xyz * scale1) + bias1; vec3 diff = main - blur; vec3 next = main + diff * 0.18 - vec3(q3, q3 * 0.7, q3 * 0.85); float swirl = 0.02 + q2 * 0.05; vec2 uv_warp = uv + vec2(diff.y - diff.z, diff.z - diff.x) * swirl; float zoom = 0.99 + q1 * 0.05; vec2 uv_zoom = (uv_warp - 0.5) * zoom + 0.5; uv_zoom.x += sin(time * 0.1) * 0.001; uv_zoom.y += cos(time * 0.13) * 0.001; uv_zoom = clamp(uv_zoom, 0.005, 0.995); vec3 col = texture(sampler_main, uv_zoom).xyz * 0.94 + next * 0.06; float r_noise = fract(sin(dot(uv + vec2(time * 0.01), vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453); col += vec3(r_noise) * 0.0018; ret = col; }
comp: shader_body { vec3 main = texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz; vec3 blur1 = (texture(sampler_blur1, uv).xyz * scale1) + bias1; vec3 blur2 = (texture(sampler_blur2, uv).xyz * scale2) + bias2; vec3 edge = abs(main - blur1) * 2.5; vec3 col = main * 1.2 + edge * 0.8 + blur2 * 0.4; vec3 palette = vec3(q6, q7, q8); col = col * (vec3(1.0) + palette * 0.3); col = pow(col, vec3(1.35)); ret = col; }
name: _Mandelbox_Explorer
